caller_parameters: pbShowCommands(nil,commands); commands are Settings::LANGUAGES display names in order. No explicit cancel/default-index argument.
complete_local_meaning: nil commands returns0 before constructing a window; [] is not nil and takes the construction/loop path.
Window creation/position/index precede loop. Each loop updates graphics/input/command/message windows, optional caller block, then checks BACK.
BACK with positive cancel code returns code−1; negative code returns itself; code0 neither exits nor skips the following USE check.
USE returns current index; normal exit disposes command window then updates Input. There is no ensure, so exceptional prior stages do not guarantee disposal.
runtime_language_join: Ordinary runtime language selection inherits cancel0: BACK alone does not return from this helper; it does not by itself advance the subsequent language-index/message-load/save writes. Under normal loop/input assumptions same-cycle BACK+USE still confirms current index. This is not EventScene BACK/USE priority.

finite_vectors.expected: No exit in this helper; no subsequent language persistence reached that iteration.
